name: Argol II - Curse of Nemesis
detailed_description:
Argol II - Curse of Nemesis is an action, platform and adventure game. The action takes place in mythological times, after the battle against Kronoss (Argol - Kronoss' Castle).

Story

Nemesis, goddess of vengeance, offered Princess Harmony, guardian of the balance of the world, a mysterious bewitched necklace that plunged her into an eternal sleep. No one can wake her up and since that day, dark creatures have been spreading throughout the country to sow death and chaos. Argol, the young and valiant warrior, must take up his sword again to face this new threat and deliver Harmony from this curse.

Gameplay

In this episode, Argol will not be alone, Evandra the Amazon and Hyperion the demigod will be at his side. Three playable and interchangeable characters at any time. In addition to their common skills (jump, attack, climb, dash, etc.), each has their own abilities. Argol has powerful attacks (diving kick, energy ball, etc.), Evandra can use her whip as a grappling hook to cross dangerous areas, while Hyperion can activate an energy shield that makes him temporarily invincible.

A map will allow you to visualize your progress and choose the order in which you want to explore the different areas, and return to them if necessary.

To achieve your goals, you will therefore need to:

  • Explore 14 levels with their own enemies and their own atmospheres: dark forest, haunted cemetery, putrid swamps, abandoned temple, labyrinth, mysterious islands and a vast castle in which Nemesis hides.

  • Face 18 Bosses inspired by mythology.

  • Ride the legendary Pegasus during 6 Shoot 'em up phases.

  • Visit the city of Argos to get information from its inhabitants, buy equipment (main and secondary weapons, armor, potions, etc.) and improve your characters' skills.

  • Discover many magical objects essential to progress in your adventure.

Options and practical information

  • The game has an automatic save system.

  • Possibility to create several game parts.

  • 4 languages ​​(English, French, Spanish, Italian).

  • 3 difficulty levels.

  • Achievements.

  • Keyboard and joypad remapping.

  • Sound adjustment.

An Argolab Games game

Graphics and Game design: Olivier Poli

Programming: Vincent Lancelot

Original soundtrack: Solon Barraclough
